AWS Architecture: SkillBridge

Four-tier design matching Blueprint to Live specifications

1. CLIENT LAYER (Students / Peers)

Mobile & Desktop Browsers • Browses profiles, 3D card inspect, builds barter proposals

2. PRESENTATION LAYER (Amazon EC2 • Nginx)

Amazon Linux 2023 EC2 Instance (`t3.micro`) • Nginx Reverse Proxy serving responsive Single Page App in `ap-southeast-2`

3. APPLICATION LOGIC (Client-Side & AWS Lambda Proposed)

Prototype: Client-side JS Matching Matrix & LocalStorage.
Production: AWS Lambda + API Gateway for proposal match validation.

4. DATA SOURCE (Mocked & Amazon DynamoDB Proposed)

Prototype: JSON dataset + LocalStorage.
Production: Amazon DynamoDB Single-Table Design (`PK=STUDENT_ID, SK=SKILL_KEY`).
